newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c.bank says cuts main rate to 47.28 pct/yr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c.bank says cuts main rate to 47.28 pct/yr.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) on Thursday confirmed it will cut its main interest rate to 47.28 percent annually from 48.72 percent, to become effective on Monday.

"The BNB board decided to set the main interest rate at 47.28 percent annually...to go in force from June 9," the BNB said in a statement. The cut was reported earlier on Thursday by local bank dealers.
The BNB said the new main rate would give 59.0 percent effective annual interest rate calculated through accumulation of monthly accruals, down from current 61.22 percent. @
The rate cut reflected a fall in the yields on Finance ministry's four-week discount T-bills this week.
The BNB adjusts the rate weekly to the weighted average effective monthly yield on four-week maturities auctioned daily from Friday through Thursday.
Yields to maturity on the T-bills auctioned since Friday ranged between 3.48-3.81 percent against 3.76-3.81 percent in the previous five days.
